simple_note_password = None
# fetch passwords from supervisor
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
for p in passwords:
    if p['account_name']=='simple_note':
        simple_note_password = p['password']
print('simple_note_password_present', bool(simple_note_password))
print('len', len(simple_note_password) if simple_note_password else None)

login_res = apis.simple_note.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=simple_note_password)
print('login_res', login_res)

# Login token already obtained earlier
simple_note_token = login_res['access_token']

# Search for bucket list related notes (paginate)
notes = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=simple_note_token,
        query='bucket',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
        sort_by='-updated_at'
    )
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    notes.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('total_notes_found', len(notes))
# print titles
for n in notes[:20]:
    print(n['note_id'], n['title'], n['pinned'], n['updated_at'])

content = bucket_res['content']
# Count completed activities marked with [x]
import re
completed = re.findall(r'^\[x\]\s+', content, flags=re.M)
not_completed = re.findall(r'^\[ \]\s+', content, flags=re.M)
print('completed_count', len(completed))
print('not_completed_count', len(not_completed))
# Also list lines for verification
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip().startswith('[')]
print('total_lines_with_status', len(lines))
print('first_lines', lines[:20])
# compute unique lines counts; maybe header line also contains [x] = done
header = bucket_res['title']
print('title', header)
